summary: Tenon Medical, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 12, 2026, disclosing entry into material definitive agreements under Items 1.01 and 5.02. Specifically, the Compensation Committee approved the 2026 Executive Compensation Plan on February 26, 2026, increasing base salaries by 5% for CEO, CFO, and COO, and modifying annual bonus opportunities with milestone-based targets. Additionally, on May 7, 2026, the Committee approved an amendment extending the consulting agreement with Executive Chairman Richard Ferrari for one year through May 6, 2027, at a quarterly compensation of $45,000. These are routine compensatory arrangements, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or corporate event is involved. The filing does not trigger any classification beyond normal governance updates.
